review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, design self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Add one standalone managed-rules refresh path before every session/startup action
review.notes: Reviewed exact e2768b40 source: CmdHQ currently seeds then StampEnrolledAll/focus/launch. Reuse existing playbook version/language decision and playbookIn; do not create a second charter generator. Shared nonblocking migration lock serializes cooperating startup/import/refresh writers. New path uses bounded no-follow owned-regular read, requires canonical managed marker and known installed language, refuses read-only/unsafe leaves, exclusive collision-safe backup with no pruning, and existing state.WritePrivateFile atomic publication. Preserve normal startup upgrade semantics and existing valid tests. Recheck original bytes/identity before publish as a best-effort manual-editor conflict guard; manual editors do not share the lock, so no external-writer atomic CAS guarantee. The lock and normal private parent handling may create/narrow managed parent directories, but unrelated files/markers/input and their payloads are untouched. No production rules refresh, TCC, input, session restore, KB apply or model calls during implementation. Targeted command tests old-red/new-green plus neighboring backup/language/help/state/race checks and normal final gates; operational install/adoption waits separate review and normal release.

cases.description: Refreshing managed HQ rules never starts, focuses, inputs or enrolls sessions
cases.setup: Actual CmdHQ with synthetic old managed en/zh HQ home, personal notes/knowledge/board, existing old backups, exact status/enrollment/input sentinels, recording tmux executable.
cases.action: Run --refresh-rules without TMUX and with tmux unavailable; compare all unrelated bytes and process calls.
cases.expected: Success publishes exactly playbookIn(current existing language), retains an exact old-file backup and all existing backups. LOCAL/notes/knowledge/board/CLAUDE pointer and unrelated status/enrollment/input bytes remain unchanged; zero tmux calls, no fresh seeding or session mutation.

cases.description: Same/newer managed rules converge and preserve the installed language
cases.setup: Existing older en/zh managed file with opposite shell language, then same-version and future-version variants; no optional personal files.
cases.action: Invoke actual standalone command twice; compare content/mtime/file list and rendered help catalog.
cases.expected: Older rules upgrade in their existing language using the common generator. Equal/newer versions remain byte/mtime identical, no new backups or optional personal/pointer files. Common/help-all and HelpFlags expose the standalone flag.

cases.description: Rules refresh cannot be combined with another HQ action
cases.setup: Fresh isolated home with per-action variants: rotate/launch target/agent/language/board/home/records/export/import/passphrase/json/brief/maintenance and duplicate refresh.
cases.action: Call actual parser with each combination before/after refresh.
cases.expected: Exit2 before lock/seeding/I/O/tmux, no files in fixture home; help retains ordinary nonmutating early return. No action precedence silently chooses a different mode.

cases.description: Rules refresh shares the existing nonblocking startup/import lock
cases.setup: Managed old rules and a held actual acquireMigrationApplyLock in the same isolated home; recording tmux and sentinels.
cases.action: Invoke while held, release lock, invoke again.
cases.expected: Contention exits1 without changing AGENTS/backup/other files; after release exactly one upgrade succeeds, no session effects or deadlock. No sleep/probabilistic race proof.

cases.description: Refresh refuses absent, unmanaged or unsafe instruction files
cases.setup: Missing home/file, unmanaged/embedded or malformed marker, unknown language, read-only AGENTS, symlink to external sentinel, directory and FIFO leaf fixtures.
cases.action: Invoke actual standalone command and compare retained original/external bytes and absence of seed files/backups.
cases.expected: Exit1 without following links/special files or blocking FIFO, without chmod repair of the source or seeding/migration. No downgrade of future versions. Only the pre-existing shared lock outside the HQ home may be created; no credentials/real homes read.

cases.description: Backups are exclusive, bounded and preserved when publication cannot start
cases.setup: Managed prior rules with collisions at version-language backup names, 100 occupied candidates, and an unwritable HQ directory; old-backup byte sentinels.
cases.action: Run command under each isolated filesystem condition, restore fixture permissions in cleanup.
cases.expected: Collisions get a fresh bounded numbered backup and never overwrite/delete existing material; full namespace or backup I/O failure exits1 with the original AGENTS unchanged. Successful publication is atomic via the existing private state writer; a post-rename sync failure may leave complete new content plus backup and is an error, not promised rollback.
